description: The issues of the shown space from Jira Cloud or GitHub, with a Repo chip for the Jira issues of the shown repository (by Jira component), a combinable Reopened urgency filter and badge, a page for each issue, comments, a Move menu for its Jira status (with a form for the fields that a move requires), a Fix version menu, a Components menu, the attachments of a Jira issue (saved into .jira/<key>/ of the space) and a Start agent dialog with a non-blocking Jira pre-flight checklist. Based on Herdr Ranch.

credit.text: Based on Herdr Ranch by Jelle Slowack (MIT license).

settings.label: Order
settings.hint: By priority: the issues in groups by priority. Backlog order: the order of the Jira backlog.

settings.label: Repo filter on
settings.hint: The Repo chip of the Jira list: only the issues of the Jira components of the repository. The chip in the list changes this too, so the choice stays for every space and after a restart.

settings.label: Page
settings.hint: Where an issue opens. Overlay: in a dialog over the window. Split: under the list. Full: in the place of the list.

settings.label: Default Jira site
settings.hint: The Jira site of the default project: every space without a Jira link of its own shows its issues. Link space can set it too (Use it for: every space without a link).

settings.label: Default Jira project
settings.hint: The key of the default project.

settings.label: Default JQL filter
settings.hint: Optional JQL that narrows the open issues of the default project. Empty: every open issue.

settings.label: Extra Jira fields
settings.hint: Jira fields for the Start agent prompts, by name or id, split by commas. Each one is a placeholder ({refinement}) and {fields} holds all of them. On the issue page a long field gets a tab, a short one a row of Details.

settings.label: Reopened statuses
settings.hint: Optional Jira status names (split by commas) that mark an open issue as reopened when it is in or passed through them. "Reopened" / "Reaberta" and Done-category statuses are detected automatically.

settings.label: Returned from statuses
settings.hint: Optional Jira status names (split by commas) that mark an open issue as reopened when it was in one of them and moved to another open status (for example, sent back from QA or Review).

settings.label: Repository components
settings.hint: The Jira components of the repository of the shown space. The Repo chip of the Jira list shows only the issues of these components. Saved in the components line of .herdr/jira.toml. Needs the Issues panel on screen.

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.hint: Opens the Issues window. Saved in keys.json.
